turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email used at checkout, and the full new delivery address so I can check whether the address can still be changed.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
The delivery address can only be changed before shipping. Your order has already shipped, so I haven’t changed the address. A colleague will take over to check what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified nora.blake@example.com requests delivery change to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu, and does not want delivery to the checkout address. Policy check returned already_shipped. No change filed; please review available options.
